}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== It's a 2-bay NAS. This device has 3x USB 2.0 ports. {{See also|Synology DiskStation Devices|List of NAS Devices}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Marvell]] 88F6281 @1.2GHz *Memory: 128MB (DDR2) SDRAM ([[Samsung]]) *Storage: 4MB (SPI NOR) Flash, 2x SATA *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet port *USB: 3x USB 2.0 ports *Power: 12V, 5.4A via barrel
